code: (async()=>{const E=window.__echoes;const tk=n=>new Promise(res=>{const t0=E.tick;const iv=setInterval(()=>{if(E.tick>=t0+n){clearInterval(iv);res()}},4)});const mm=(x,y)=>window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{clientX:x,clientY:y}));const kd=c=>window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:c}));const ku=c=>window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:c}));const st=()=>E.state();async function aimAt(wx,wz){let sx=800,sy=450;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const probe=[[sx,sy],[sx+120,sy],[sx,sy-90]];const ws=[];for(const[px,py]of probe){mm(px,py);await tk(3);const a=st().party[0].aim;ws.push([a.x,a.z])}const ax=(ws[1][0]-ws[0][0])/120,bx=(ws[2][0]-ws[0][0])/(-90),az=(ws[1][1]-ws[0][1])/120,bz=(ws[2][1]-ws[0][1])/(-90);const det=ax*bz-bx*az;if(Math.abs(det)<1e-9)break;const dx=wx-ws[0][0],dz=wz-ws[0][1];sx+=(dx*bz-bx*dz)/det;sy+=(ax*dz-dx*az)/det}mm(sx,sy);await tk(3);return st().party[0].aim}const log={};log.g=E.cmd('giveSkill','spirit_bolt');E.cmd('teleport',-0.5,1.0);log.did=E.cmd('spawn','dummy',4.0,1.0);await tk(50);log.aim=await aimAt(4.0,1.0);kd('Digit3');await tk(2);ku('Digit3');await tk(10);log.bolt=st().skillBolts;return log})()
